patterns: Generation currently uses asynchronous theater creation: Service.GenerateTheater saves GENERATING placeholder, then generateTheaterAsync fills dialogues, quiz, and TTS audio.
Reading generation is synchronous for content and asynchronous for reading audio: GenerateReadingMaterial generates/saves content, then starts generateReadingAudio in a goroutine.
difficulty currently affects requiredQuizCount only for listening: difficulty >= 7.0 returns 3 questions, otherwise 2.
Reading difficulty is inferred coarsely from exam: IELTS defaults to 6.5, CET to 5.5; level is stored as a string but does not drive meaningful prompt variation.
Current reading AI path passes topic as '[IELTS Reading] {topic}', then concatenates dialogue paragraphs into passage text.
Prompt catalog files are embedded, but generator.go currently builds the main reading/dialogue prompts inline.
Fallback reading content exists in two places: fallbackReadingGeneratedContent near GenerateReadingMaterial and fallbackReadingContent via fallbackGeneratedContent.
TTS retries happen inside ai/tts.go for timeout errors only; service.go marks reading audio FAILED on the first failed chunk.
